messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Symmetry-constrained ansatz parameterized by a few variables then globally optimized

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "A configuration achieving the largest minimum triangle area for 13 points in the unit square is given by the four corners, four points at (t,0), (1−t,1), (1,t), and (0,1−t) for t ≈ 0.345, and five interior points consisting of the center (1/2,1/2) plus four points at (1/2±s, 1/2±s) and (1/2±s, 1/2∓s) for s ≈ 0.190. Globally optimizing over t and s to equalize the binding area constraints yields a minimum triangle area of approximately 0.0104."}
